resources.string: Turn on "Phyrexian Keyboard" in your system keyboard list.
Tap any text field, open the keyboard switcher, and pick Phyrexian Keyboard.

This keyboard lets you type in glyphs on the key caps and preview bar. The text it sends to apps is normal English text, so it can be read by anyone — it will only *look* Phyrexian to people who also have the Phyrexia Neue font installed, or if you send a screenshot.
